item.title: A90/A928 (Southbound)
item.description:
🟠 Traffic restriction
• The A90 southbound off and on slips at Gateside, near Forfar, are closed due to overnight roadworks.
Updated: 18:54

item.title: A92 Crossgates (Northbound)
item.description:
🟠 Traffic restriction
• The M90 Northbound, Junction 2a Slip to the A92 is closed, this is to allow for essential overnight roadworks.

item.title: M90 Ferrytoll (Southbound)
item.description:
🟠 Traffic restrictions
• The M90 Queensferry Crossing is closed southbound , junction 1b to junction 1a to allow for essential overnight roadworks. These works include the closure of M90 southbound junction 1b on slip and M90 southbound junction 1a off slip.
Updated: 21:42
